THE GENESIS PLAN

From neural output to a token's first transaction.

Genesis is the proposed origin experiment for $ZNEURO: connect a controller-generated action to a prepared Pons launch. The shared browser already runs on article pages. The next milestone is a Pons-specific trial without sending a transaction.

  1. 01 / OBSERVE

    Screen to retinal input

    A browser adapter would turn the Pons screen into visual input for the controller.

  2. 02 / ACT

    Motor output to action

    Motor output would drive cursor movement and an explicit launch trigger. The operator supplies token settings and approves signing.

  3. 03 / RECORD

    An inspectable origin

    An aligned record would connect visual inputs, model outputs, browser actions and the confirmed launch transaction.
